description: Dedicated entries for culturally distinct emergency signals and luxury beacons.

entries.title: Dwarven Flare Guns
entries.summary: Durable rune-etched firearms launch color-coded magical distress flares from replaceable alchemical cartridges.
body: Steel and brass construction suits miners, merchants, and crews in rugged Messaran terrain. Red signals danger, blue medical aid, and green rescue, though fog and storms reduce visibility and every shot requires reloading.

entries.title: Elven Sending Stones
entries.summary: Paired enchanted crystals transmit a short spoken message and the sender's location across a limited distance.
body: Travelers, diplomats, and Elven guardians activate polished gemstone or quartz stones by touch and incantation. They work only with their linked partner and normally require magical enhancement beyond ten miles.

sections.heading: Legacy Range
body: The source specifies a ten-mile ordinary range. Conversion is required.

entries.title: Gnomish Safety Signal Reflectors
entries.summary: Folding mirrored panels send coded flashes, with advanced versions supplying their own magical light.
body: Lightweight alloys and intricate hinges make the reflectors portable on islands and decks. They require a trained operator and clear visibility; heavy cloud and poor weather can make them useless.

entries.title: Human Signal Flares
entries.summary: Cheap alchemical torches combine colored light and whistles for short-lived, easily understood warnings.
body: Caravan guards and adventurers ignite wooden or metal flare sticks by flint or pull cord. Red means danger, yellow caution, and white safety, but their burn time and visibility are limited.

entries.title: Dragonkin Fire Orbs
entries.summary: Single-use dragon-egg-shaped devices burst into radiant fire visible for miles.
body: Dragon Kin warriors and scouts carry ornate rune-marked orbs as both emergency tools and marks of honor. They are activated by throwing or shattering and are expensive to replace.

entries.title: Halfling Sky Lanterns
entries.summary: Enchanted paper lanterns rise on small burners, leaving glowing trails for emergencies and celebrations.
body: Their dual ceremonial and rescue use makes them common in Halfling communities. Strong wind and heavy rain can destroy or divert them.

entries.title: Orcish War Horns
entries.summary: Carved horns use thunderous coded tones to summon allies and report emergencies in remote regions.
body: Animal horn or metal construction is decorated with tribal patterns and battle scars. The signal needs no light or magic, but cannot communicate beyond hearing range or reach allies without listeners.

entries.title: Luxury Emergency Beacons
entries.summary: Wealthy travelers use customized Aetherflare Globes, continuous Arcane Beacons, and message-bearing Windcall Amulets.
body: Aetherflare Globes display crests, sound, or recorded messages. Arcane Beacons project persistent light and report location to nearby mages. Crushed Windcall Amulets summon an air elemental to carry a message to a predetermined recipient.
These devices are reliable and prestigious but expensive, technically demanding, or single-use.
